name: Share Actions
summary: Fail-closed named group of target-selected canonical share actions with intrinsic inline or stacked layout, curated semantic action ids, arbitrary custom actions, and target-owned capabilities and results.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Generic named role=group containing one finite ordered set of independent share actions; it is not a toolbar, menu or fixed rail.

anatomy.name: action
anatomy.description: Contextual hook composed on a canonical Button root rendered as a native button for an operation or anchor for a destination.

variants.name: inline
variants.description: Intrinsic wrapping row of canonical actions.

variants.name: stacked
variants.description: Intrinsic vertical action group without fixed or sticky viewport placement.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Root owns no action size; each canonical Button composition retains its reviewed size.

states.name: default
states.description: Valid named group with at least one target-capable action.

states.name: hover
states.description: Canonical Button hover presentation; L9 adds no parallel state.

states.name: active
states.description: Canonical Button active presentation; L9 adds no persistent shared state.

states.name: focusVisible
states.description: Canonical Button focus indicator with ordinary sequential Tab order.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Truthful action-local canonical unavailable state; capability-unavailable share actions are omitted rather than rendered as dead controls.

states.name: busy
states.description: Optional truthful target-owned pending action projected through canonical Button.

behavior.name: nativeActionSemantics
behavior.description: Native Share and Copy are target-enhanced Buttons. Email, verified provider flows and custom destinations are anchors with real target-supplied href values. Canonical Button owns visual and focus behavior.

behavior.name: hybridActionCatalogue
behavior.description: Consumers select and order zero or more curated semantic ids plus arbitrary custom canonical actions. The component never renders the whole catalogue by default and ids do not freeze provider URLs or support claims.

behavior.name: capabilityOmission
behavior.description: The current target omits any selected action it cannot truthfully perform. It does not render a disabled dead provider action or silently substitute Native Share or Copy.

behavior.name: targetOwnedResult
behavior.description: Targets own payload, canonical URL, encoding, capability checks, permissions, popup/new-context security, promise success/cancel/error, fallback, status announcement, analytics and cleanup. L9 adds no neutral runtime or fabricated success.

behavior.name: failClosed
behavior.description: A blank localized group label or zero valid target-capable actions omits the complete group. Duplicate action ids and blank labels are invalid.

behavior.name: hostPlacement
behavior.description: Fixed/sticky placement, safe areas, collision avoidance, z-index, mobile relocation and print behavior belong to the page host or a separately reviewed Share Rail.

properties.name: variant
properties.description: Semantic inline wrapping or stacked intrinsic layout; it never promises viewport placement.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Non-empty localized accessible name for the complete related-action group.

properties.name: actions
properties.description: Ordered non-empty composition of target-capable canonical Button or anchor Button actions. It may resolve curated semantic ids or arbitrary custom actions; no action is implicit.

accessibility: Give the generic role=group one required localized accessible name and every action a complete visible localized label.
Use native button type=button for operations and native anchors with real href values for destinations; do not add toolbar, menu, selection, aria-current, aria-pressed or roving-focus semantics.
Preserve ordinary Tab order, native Enter/Space activation and canonical Button focus, disabled and busy behavior.
Omit capability-unavailable actions. Do not expose a focusable dead provider action or silently relabel a different fallback as that provider.
Targets expose truthful asynchronous success or failure through an accepted status pattern only after the real result; cancellation is not automatically an error and L9 owns no live region.
Keep complete labels, at least canonical Button target size, intrinsic reflow, RTL order, forced-color boundaries and reduced-motion behavior.

web.notes: Named fail-closed group, inline/stacked CSS and canonical Button composition are implemented with zero neutral runtime. A consuming target supplies capabilities, href values, handlers and real feedback.

shopify.notes: A future storefront/app consumer selects valid actions, canonical resource data, localized labels, verified provider mappings and progressive native/copy feedback; copied CSS alone is not readiness.

react.notes: Thin named group around target-supplied canonical action elements; hooks/services own capability and asynchronous results.

swiftui.notes: Map semantic ids to target-capable ShareLink/share-sheet, clipboard or custom native actions; omit unsupported ids.

compose.notes: Map semantic ids to Android share intents, clipboard or custom native actions while keeping capability/result policy target-owned.
